note: Catalog of camper conversion modules. `footprint` is the installed zone the module occupies in the vehicle frame: length runs front–rear (x), width runs across the vehicle (y), height from the cabin floor. `product` is the bare appliance/part. Prices are Indian-market ranges, supply + basic fitting, excluding GST unless the source included it. `confidence`: web_quoted = an Indian listing or price list found in a web search on the as_of date; estimated_from_import = overseas list price × typical Indian import landed cost (duty, freight, dealer margin, roughly 1.6–2.2×); estimated = builder-fabricated item, priced from Indian conversion-cost guides. Replace any entry with a real supplier quote when you have one and set confidence to "quoted".

layout_rules.note: Modules are laid out rear-wards from the partition in fixed zones with this gap; nothing may overlap. Whatever is left at the rear is the walkway to the rear doors. A module may only span a wheel housing if it sets clears_wheel_housing (its floor structure is above the housing height).

components.name: Cab partition wall with door
components.price_basis: Ply + laminate bulkhead with a hinged door, fabricated by an Indian caravan builder; part of the ₹5–10 lakh interior build-up quoted in 2026 conversion guides.

components.name: Crew bunk (two stacked berths)
components.orientation: transverse — berths run across the vehicle, so the zone is only one mattress width long
components.price_basis: Ply frame, two foam mattresses and ladder, builder-fabricated. Caravan bunks are typically 700–800 mm wide and 1800–1900 mm long.
components.clearance_note: Lower deck at 400 mm is above the 350 mm wheel housing.

components.name: Kitchenette (counter, 2-burner hob + sink combo)
components.price_basis: Low end: Indian SS sink + 2-burner LPG hob (₹5–12k) in a builder-made laminate counter (₹25–60k). High end: imported Smev 9222 (UK £285–365 list) landed at roughly ₹40–60k plus the counter.

variants.name: Dometic CRX 50 (built-in, 45 L)
variants.price_basis: UK/EU list ≈ £550–650; no Indian price list found. Landed estimate.

variants.name: Portable 45 L 12/24 V compressor fridge (Indian marketplace brands)
variants.price_basis: Amazon.in 12 V compressor car fridges listed ₹9,190–65,990 (Sept 2026); 45 L class sits mid-range.

components.name: Lounge bench
components.price_basis: Ply box bench with storage and upholstered cushions, builder-fabricated.
components.clearance_note: Box bench is built around the wheel housing; seat at 460 mm is above it.

components.name: Enclosed toilet cubicle
components.price_basis: Cubicle shell only (FRP or laminate ply). IndiaMART: FRP portable washroom from ₹30,000; 'motor home toilet' module for camper van ₹90,000 (Kalol, Gujarat). Toilet unit priced separately below.

variants.name: Thetford Porta Potti Qube 365 (portable, 21 L waste)
variants.price_basis: Listed on Amazon.in and Flipkart India; US RRP $260. Indian listings typically ₹15–25k.

variants.name: Thetford C223-S cassette toilet (fixed, external cassette hatch)
variants.price_basis: US list $670; needs a cut-out hatch in the body side. No Indian price list found.

components.name: Fresh water tank, 100 L, with 12 V pump
components.price_basis: Sintex 100 L loft tank ₹1,100–2,200 (household grade) up to a vehicle-grade PE tank; plus 12 V pump, filler and plumbing ₹4–15k. A wheel-arch style camper tank of this capacity is ~750 × 400 × 350 mm.

components.name: Electrical cabinet (inverter, 100 Ah LiFePO4, DC distribution)

parts.name: 1000–1500 VA pure sine inverter/charger
parts.price_basis: Luminous 1500 VA ECO Watt ₹12,950 (IndiaMART); 1 kW class ₹9–19.5k.

variants.name: 32" LED TV
variants.price_basis: 91mobiles/Smartprix Sept 2026: budget 32" smart TVs ₹11,999–17,899; typical panel 722–731 × 421–432 mm.

variants.name: 43" LED TV
variants.price_basis: Sept 2026: Compaq 43" ₹10,999 (low), Samsung DUE76 ₹26,990, Sony W830K ₹33,000; typical panel ≈ 953 × 536 mm.
